{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Every American deserves a secure, healthy, and dignified retirement.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"America's seniors have earned their Medicare and Social Security through a lifetime of hard work and personal responsibility.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Obama is committed to preserving Medicare and Social Security for this and future generations.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Americans contribute to Social Security during their working years in exchange for a promise of income in retirement.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"We will find a solution to protect Social Security for future generations.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"We will block Republican efforts to subject Americans' guaranteed retirement income to the whims of the stock market through privatization.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"We reject approaches that insist that cutting benefits is the only answer to Social Security.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"President Obama will make it easier for Americans to save for retirement and prepare for unforeseen expenses by participating in retirement accounts at work.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
